title: evidence_row
description: One JSON line per fetched page or search result. WRITTEN BY THE FETCHER, NEVER BY THE MODEL — a schema that forces a model to fill an evidence field manufactures citations. The model may only cite ids that already exist here.

id.description: the ONLY thing a claim may cite

kind.description: discovery = a headline. evidence = a fetched body.

gap.description: the named information gap the query was closing

pub_date.description: 'recently' is not a value; null is honest, a guess is not

dates_agree.description: two independent extractors agreed; false means treat as undated

passage.description: VERBATIM, from the fetched BODY — never a search snippet

passage_sha256.description: recomputed by gate.py; a mismatch is a hard failure

cluster_id.description: assigned by independence.py; evidence, never a verdict
